description.value: Church's Chicken (operating here as Church's Texas Chicken) is a fried chicken fast food chain with a Lower Mainland BC franchise presence. The Hastings Street location is one of roughly 19 outlets listed on the regional franchise website, serving hand-battered chicken meals, sandwiches, tenders, and Honey-Butter biscuits. It is a potential quick-stop option for touring cyclists on the East Hastings corridor.
